KP17592186115242; steps 3–7, exact arithmetic, no database operations.
Observed complete bank profiles are explicit arithmetic patterns, with
unresolved scalar error intent documented. They are never the default bank.
Source masks contain complete mathematical slots, not numeric substring
replacements. Normal sampling uses assessed-operation distractor banks. All
three levels are supported.
